# Book of Giants Fragment 12 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Book of Giants Fragment 12 (Final Fragments) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 12:5 — "filled with violence / overflowed with violence"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "all the-earth was-filled with-violence" — echoes Gen 6:11 |
| LOGOS | "all the earth was filled with violence" — formal, preserves Genesis echo |
| PNEUMA | "The whole earth overflowed with violence" — "overflowed" substitutes for "filled" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "filled with violence." This directly echoes Genesis 6:11 (male'a hamas), which is clearly the intended allusion.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 12:7 — "preserved / chose to spare"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "those-whom God preserved" — literal natar |
| LOGOS | "those whom God preserved" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "those God chose to spare" — adds "chose" and changes verb |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "those whom God preserved." The Aramaic natar means to keep/preserve; PNEUMA's "chose to spare" adds a selection concept.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 12:15 — "grew up / sprang up from its soil"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "righteousness grew-up upon-it" — literal |
| LOGOS | "righteousness grew up upon it" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "righteousness sprang up from its soil" — adds "soil" and changes verb |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "righteousness grew up upon it." The Aramaic is straightforward; PNEUMA's addition of "soil" is unnecessary embellishment.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements for Fragment 12: 3*
